header.userPrompt: Fix all compilation warnings in this sbt project (cross-built for Scala 2.12, 2.13 and 3). Run 'sbt +compile +Test/compile' (or equivalent) to surface the warnings, especially those introduced by the staged upgrade to Scala 3.9.0, zio 2.1.27, zio-opentelemetry 3.1.21 and OpenTelemetry 1.67.0. Fix the root causes in source (deprecations, unused imports, etc.) rather than silencing them with -nowarn, and make sure the build compiles warning-free on all Scala versions and tests still pass.
